items.label: Good Helper for Moving Furniture
items.value: Are you still worrying about moving furniture? Using this heavy-duty furniture lift with wheels, you can easily slide heavy furniture from one place to another and rearrange or clean your home or office. Not only can it save your back and waist, but it can also save your floor. One person can deal with it easily. Even ladies can easily operate.

items.label: Easy To Operate
items.value: Use the principle of leverage. You can easily lift one side of the furniture; then put the pulley under the foot of the furniture, if you need to raise the height can be put to raise the cushion,then put in the moving dolly on the bottom of the furniture,and lock the universal wheel,the four furniture moving wheels into the bottom of the furniture,and then open the universal wheel brake,without the help of others,you can easily move furniture and other heavy objects.

items.label: Protect your furniture
items.value: High-quality thickened velvet anti-skid pads can prevent damage to your furniture when moving it, and L-shaped edge design can better protect your furniture from slipping off the cart. The L-shaped sides are on the outside, and as long as the furniture occupies more than 80% of the area of the cart, it can be perfectly moved.

items.label: High Material Furniture Dolly
items.value: It is absolutely the first consideration to ensure that the furniture and floor are not damaged. The furniture lifting crowbar is made of durable steel, and has a non-slip design. The surface of the 4 sliding rails is made of thickened carbon steel, which will not damage the furniture. Each slide is inlaid with 5 360° Rotation Wheels universal wheels, a total of 20 universal wheels, flexible and durable, up to 1800 lbs load-bearing, it will not damage the floor.

items.label: Widely Use
items.value: Furniture dolly 5 wheels are suitable for household appliances in the home. Use them for you bed, sofa, coffee table, bedside table, cabinet, refrigerator, dryer, washing machine, bookcase, piano, dressing table, garage and more.4 self-adhesive velvet anti-slip pads are pasted on furniture mover dolly panels,which can effectively keep objects from slipping during transportation.It is easy to move around on flat ground, but it is difficult to move on cracked ground and blankets.

items.label: Product Package and Excellent service
items.value: You will receive a retractable furniture elevator, 4 increase pad, 4 carts, and 4 flannel anti slip pads for individuals. It's convenient for you to lift up and move furniture and not need to buy extra one.If you have any questions about this flexible little guy, please feel free to contact us. We will answer and handle your questions as soon as we receive them.
